dummy_proof: Parse the sealed generated seed BINARY Bound.vtk: actual8 big-endian float points, IDs0..7, fixed Type0, stationary velocity and positive rho. neighbor_predicate: cKDTree query supplies a conservative radius superset; each pair is then filtered using CPU-model rr2=float32((dx*dx+dy*dy)+dz*dz), with double native coordinate differences, rr2<=float32(float32(2*h)^2), rr2>=float32(1e-18), and positive volume. Includes all soil and8 actual seed dummy points. Native-ID ordering is deterministic for witnesses, not historical cell ordering.
nzero_counterfactual: Explicit CPU expression: cast final to float32 of float32(4/3)*3.141592*R2*R2/(dp^3). The contrast replaces one R2 factor by R, giving R2*R, and otherwise keeps coefficient/casts/denominator. nzero/float32(neigh) and cutofffloat32(.4) are used. This numerator-only dimensional contrast is NOT an approved fix, not a changed inequality and not a claim of literal historical GPU arithmetic replay.
classification_limit: Enums are Inner0, NearFreeSurface1, FreeSurface2, Isolated3, Boundary4. Preserve actual FS0/1/2 unmodified. Only actual FS3 with positive counted neighbors logically implies its old pre-umbrella threshold was<1.8 under the documented branch. For those no longer satisfying the R3 ratio<.4, hypothetically start fromFS2 and apply CPU3D umbrella using the actual native float FSNormal, without renormalization. Witness makes itInner0, otherwiseFS2. Actual FS3 with zero neighbors remains3. No numerical fs_threshold/PosDiv is fabricated, and no full pre/post classification rebuild is claimed.
umbrella: Model source JSphCpu.cpp ScanUmbrellaFreeSurface: float coordinate differences and rr2, raw native float normal, norm2<=1e-12 skip; split rr2>2*h*h, far q-distance<h or near acos(clamp(-dr dot normal /sqrt(rr2)))<float32(.785398). Log normal norm2 margin, minimum absolute branch/far/angle margins, ratio margins and closest support margin.
